name: Aera shan Ravanór
summary: A Wood-elf Rogue, the party's lead scout, archer and lockpicker.

facts.text: Gained a pseudodragon companion at Argynvostholt and found hidden relics behind a painting.
Recited the knight's oath that awakened Horngaard's prophecy and received Arrigal's secret note.
Reached Level 7 and gained Evasion; scouted the Heart of Sorrow alone and met Strahd.
Flew to Ravenloft's parapets, stole the wights' alarm horns and lowered the drawbridge.
Picked the lock to the King's Bedchamber and gave amber teeth for Olfin's Revivify.
Took the bat-style bone wings and shot the Abbot through the heart with a second natural 20.
Walked through St. Markovia's false door hoping to reach her lost husband and children; it was a trap.
Received the Reliquary of Two Flames holding the echoes of Liren and Gumbo.

name: Malron Lichtstrahl
summary: A Reborn Cleric of Lathander and spirit medium whose body is shared with an ancient elven spirit.

facts.text: Noticed pulleys and a Strahd mannequin used to scare intruders at Castle Ravenloft.
Was brought back by a botched resurrection that let an elven spirit share his body; needs no breath or food.
Pulled Olfin out of a hall of 40 zombies with an invisible Mage Hand and telekinesis.
Found the Icon of Dawn's Grace in Saint Markovia's crypt, and the Icon speaks to him telepathically.
Killed Anastrasya with Scorching Ray and revived Olfin with a scroll of Revivify.
Revived Olfin with his saved 3rd-level slot and helped redeem the Abbot by calling on St. Markovia.
Warned Aera that the false meadow was a trap and read Strahd's mocking letter aloud.

name: Zorpheus
summary: A mysterious wanderer and bard drawn to fate and prophecy.

facts.text: Explored Argynvostholt with Aera and Malron.
Helped Sasha clean spilled wine and received her tip about the organ's sixth pedal.
Was asked by Sasha to rescue Gertruda and was escorted upstairs by Escher.

name: Shabasta
summary: A porcupine Bard of fate with a prickly, satirical wit.

facts.text: Reached Level 7 and gained Dimension Door and Silvery Barbs.
Earned the nickname "Shipnasty" and cast Vicious Mockery at the bone mounds in the Hall of Bones.
Was grappled and dragged up the wall by Volenta Popofsky.
Lied to the Belviews that Cyrus had been "perfected" and cast Heat Metal on the Abbot's gauntlets.
Was polymorphed into a giant ape that soaked about 124 damage from the Fallen Star.
Was a druid's sheep for a time, died, and was reincarnated as Shabasta again.
Is the brother of Doru, whose voice spoke from the Abbot's first vessel.

name: Olfin Darning
summary: A Hexblood Paladin who carries the Symbol of Ravenkind.

facts.text: Took half of a tarnished silver locket from a silver box atop the ancient oak.
Wields the Symbol of Ravenkind, and his Aura of Devotion protects allies from charm.
Grabbed Cyrus's heirloom spoon from a hall of zombies, then was teleported into an Iron Maiden by a trap.
Broke Gertruda's charm with Protection from Evil and Good; was killed by Anastrasya and revivified.
Took the eagle-style bone wings, whose command word is "America!", and started the fight with the Abbot.
Died and, in a heroic moment, landed a 47-point smite that killed the Fallen Star; Malron revived him.
Has the Sentinel feat and led the way down past the red door.

name: Krusty
summary: A Wizard (High Elf Sage Wizard) new to the party, later revealed as a Divination wizard.

facts.text: Joined as a Level 7 wizard commanding Polymorph and Greater Invisibility.
Cast Fly and Invisibility on Aera so she could cross the chasm to Ravenloft.
Used Reduce on Argynvost's skull to fit it into the Chest of Holding.
Attuned to the Staff of Khazan after solving the rune puzzle.
Has a tawny owl familiar and hit dire wolves with Lightning Bolt.
Counterspelled the Abbot's healing touch.
Polymorphed Shabasta into a giant ape and took no damage in the fight.
Revealed he is a Divination wizard.

name: Gumbo
summary: A pragmatic Half-orc Rogue and old companion of the party.

facts.text: Was part of the party at Argynvostholt and on the road to Barovia's gates.
Was handed a sword to judge a prisoner and found a map in a clock showing the castle's beating heart.
Returned from the abbey well with Liren after being long thought lost.
Faded into the Reliquary of Two Flames after the first vessel was destroyed.

name: Liren
summary: A Dragonborn Barbarian, wary of everyone but Malron.

facts.text: Was listed among the party at Argynvostholt.
Returned from the abbey well with Gumbo; for them only hours had passed.
Killed the Abbot's first vessel with her battleaxe.
Faded into the Reliquary of Two Flames.

name: Oogway
summary: A turtle Wizard Bladesinger.

facts.text: Was part of the party at Argynvostholt and on the road east.
Arrived at Castle Ravenloft with the party.

name: Strahd von Zarovich
summary: The vampire lord and master of Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Murdered his brother Sergei and seeks Ireena, believing she is Tatyana reborn.
Hosted the party at Castle Ravenloft and recommended they visit the Amber Temple.
Granted the party resistance to necrotic damage for 36 hours, saying "The cows have teeth after all."
Follows a 14-day hunting cycle, which the party planned to exploit.
Was seen leaving the castle on his nightmare, Beucephalus.
Sent dire wolves, scarecrows and a duplicate of Aera's corpse to punish her for stealing.
Left a mocking letter in a black carriage: "Even the dead return for an encore."

name: Rahadin
summary: Strahd's chamberlain at Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Greeted the party when they arrived at Castle Ravenloft.
Brought a chained prisoner for judgment and locked the party in the guest room.
Uses the tomb of King Barov and Queen Ravenovia (K88) as his sanctuary.
Escorted the party out of Ravenloft the morning after their stay.
Attacked the party in the catacombs, surrounded by a deathly choir of screaming voices.
Was wounded and retreated from the catacomb fight.

name: Anastrasya
summary: A vampire bride of Strahd.

facts.text: Greeted the party at Castle Ravenloft and controlled Sasha with biting remarks.
Attacked the party in the King's Bedchamber with two wights to reclaim Gertruda.
Turned into a giant bat abomination and killed Olfin with a bite.
Was destroyed by Malron's Scorching Ray.

name: Volenta Popofsky
summary: A vampire bride of Strahd.

facts.text: Had red wine spilled on her white dress at Strahd's reception.
Held the key to Emil's Silver Thorn Collar and appeared on the torture chamber balcony with a jar of oil.
Fought with poisoned daggers and ice shards and took on a winged monstrous form.
Was pinned to the wall and killed; her key freed Emil.

name: Ludmilla
summary: A vampire bride present at Strahd's reception.

facts.text: Was present in the Castle Ravenloft grand hall when the party arrived.

name: Escher
summary: A blonde vampire at Castle Ravenloft, once a friend of Doru.

facts.text: Was introduced by Anastrasya and is suspected of betraying Doru.
Escorted Zorpheus upstairs and guarded the party's guest room overnight.

name: Sasha
summary: A trembling, widowed servant at Castle Ravenloft who secretly helps the party.

facts.text: Told Zorpheus, "Sixth pedal from the left on the organ."
Begged the party to rescue Gertruda and revealed a rear servants' entrance.
Shared Strahd's oldest password: "I come in Dostron's memory."

name: Diabola
summary: A resident of Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Told the party that lightning had disabled the bridge until morning.

name: Doru
summary: A dissolved vampire spawn whose intelligence helped the party plan their heist; Shabasta's brother.

facts.text: Was a friend of Escher, who is believed to have betrayed him.
Was once engaged to Gertruda.
Was dissolved in running water, but his information formed the basis of the party's map.
His voice spoke from the Abbot's first vessel; he is called Shabasta's brother.

name: Gertruda
summary: Mary's daughter from the Village of Barovia, held at Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Sasha asked the party to rescue her; she was once Doru's fiancée.
Was confirmed to be in the King's Bedchamber.
Her slipper was found on a spiral staircase.
Was freed from Strahd's charm by Olfin and rescued from the King's Bedchamber.
Was returned safely to the Village of Barovia.

name: Mary
summary: Gertruda's mother in the Village of Barovia.

facts.text: Is named as Gertruda's mother.
Lives in Barovia village.

name: Ismark the Lesser
summary: Burgomaster of Barovia and Ireena's brother.

facts.text: Had sent Gertruda out to recover after she was lost on the road to Vallaki.
Welcomed the party to the Burgomaster's mansion and was proud of his sister Ireena's growth.

name: Ireena Kolyana
summary: The woman Strahd is obsessed with, under the party's protection.

facts.text: Strahd seeks her, believing she is Tatyana reincarnated.
Stays in Vallaki as part of the party's reserve force.
Left Castle Ravenloft with the party and is under their protection in Vallaki.
Crypt 18 in the catacombs was prepared for her, empty and swept clean.
Closely resembles the portrait of Tatyana in the King's Bedchamber.

name: Tatyana
summary: The woman whose death triggered Strahd's curse.

facts.text: Took her own life, which set off Strahd's curse.
Her portrait hangs in the King's Bedchamber, wearing a silver moon-and-stars bracelet.

name: Sergei von Zarovich
summary: Strahd's murdered brother, met as a skeletal rider.

facts.text: Appeared as a skeletal rider and said Strahd murdered him.
His tomb (K85) is described as an unnatural beacon.
His tomb is well lit and blocked by a portcullis.

name: Ezmerelda d’Avenir
summary: A famed monster hunter travelling with and advising the party.

facts.text: Stays in Vallaki as part of the party's reserve force.
Left Castle Ravenloft with the party by carriage.
Told the party the Abbot can be cleansed by defeating him and using the Icon of Dawn's Grace.

name: Rudolph van Richten
summary: A vampire hunter who gave the party maps of Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Provided the castle maps that turned the infiltration into a planned heist.

name: Emil Toranescu
summary: A werewolf leader held prisoner in Castle Ravenloft, later freed.

facts.text: The party planned to rescue him to break Strahd's alliance with the werewolves.
Was found in the Drowning Cells, exhausted and bound by a Silver Thorn Collar.
Was freed with the key taken from Volenta.
Helped the party open Saint Markovia's crypt.
Stays with the party as they head toward the werewolf den.

name: Cyrus Belview
summary: A hunchbacked mongrelfolk cook at Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: A man resembling him was seen in the castle kitchen.
Asked the party to find his favorite cooking spoon in the ossuary.
Traded a map of the Serpent's Wing for his real, oversized heirloom spoon.
Was sent to Ravenloft to be "perfected"; Shabasta lied to his siblings about him.

name: Clovin Belview
summary: A mongrelfolk at the Abbey of St. Markovia.

facts.text: Carried porridge to the padlocked shed in the abbey courtyard.
Gave the party two sets of bone wings for news of Cyrus.

name: Otto Belview
summary: A mongrelfolk at the abbey's north gate.

facts.text: Asked about Cyrus and believed Shabasta's lie that he had been perfected.

name: Zygfrek Belview
summary: A mongrelfolk at the abbey's north gate.

facts.text: Asked about Cyrus and believed Shabasta's lie that he had been perfected.

name: Madam Eva
summary: A Vistani seer, revealed as Katarina, who survived Strahd's wrath.

facts.text: As Katarina, wrote a farewell letter to Varushka left by the ancient oak.
Stanimir is her messenger.

name: Varushka
summary: The recipient of Katarina's farewell letter, whose spirit the party laid to rest.

facts.text: Katarina's letter at the ancient oak is addressed to her.
The party had laid her spirit to rest, which earned Stanimir's goodwill.

name: Stanimir
summary: A Vistani elder and messenger of Madam Eva.

facts.text: Met the party near Sarepool and gave them a Clairvoyance Stone.

name: Arrigal
summary: A contact who passed Aera a secret note.

facts.text: Left Aera a note at the Blue Water Inn about a spy in Castle Ravenloft.

name: Minodora
summary: A restless spirit at Argynvostholt.

facts.text: Begged the party not to help Strahd and pointed them to Brother Merik's book.

name: Brother Merik
summary: The former chaplain of the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: His book of prayer is said to be in the west bedchambers of Argynvostholt.

name: Argynvost
summary: The silver dragon who led the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: His journal records his vow to fight in his true dragon form and defend the valley.
A prophecy says his light will return when his skull rests in its rightful tomb.
His skull was used as decoration in the Hall of Bones.

name: Andral
summary: The writer of a letter urging Argynvost to make peace with Strahd.

facts.text: Signed a scroll asking Argynvost to end the war with Lord von Zarovich.

name: Vladimir Horngaard
summary: A figure at Argynvostholt who leads phantom warriors.

facts.text: Guards a gargoyle statue on Argynvostholt's fourth floor and believes Barovia's suffering is penance.
Is enraged by the party's assault on Ravenloft, according to a Revenant.

name: Lady Fiona Wachter
summary: A noble connected to a three-pointed star crest.

facts.text: A three-pointed star crest was intended for her.

name: King Dostron the Hellborn
summary: An ancient king entombed in Crypt 34 of Ravenloft's catacombs.

facts.text: Strahd's oldest password is "I come in Dostron's memory."
His crypt (34) was a target of the heist.
His ghostly voice warned the party off, but they took the Spear of the Huntress from his sarcophagus.

name: King Barov
summary: A former king entombed with Queen Ravenovia beneath Ravenloft.

facts.text: His tomb with Queen Ravenovia (K88) is Rahadin's sanctuary.

name: Queen Ravenovia
summary: A former queen entombed with King Barov beneath Ravenloft.

facts.text: Her tomb with King Barov (K88) is Rahadin's sanctuary.

name: Khazan
summary: A dead archmage entombed in Crypt 15.

facts.text: His tomb held a rune puzzle that revealed the Staff of Khazan.

name: Growmor Nimblenobs
summary: A wizard entombed in Crypt 37.

facts.text: His staff opened a hidden compartment holding Fireball, Lightning Bolt and Cone of Cold scrolls.

name: Saint Markovia
summary: A saint whose spirit still answers in Barovia.

facts.text: Her crypt (40) held a relic the party needed.
Her remains held the Icon of Dawn's Grace.
Appeared in the void, called the Abbot by his name, Ethereal, and forgave him.
An illusion of her offered the party a false door out of Barovia.

name: Arabelle
summary: A Vistani girl.

facts.text: Olfin had recovered a silver moon-and-stars bracelet for her, the same one shown in Tatyana's portrait.

name: Dmitri Krezkov
summary: The baron of Krezk.

facts.text: Begged the party at the Blue Water Inn to save his wife Anna from the Abbot.
Leads Krezk with his wife Anna.

name: Anna Krezkova
summary: Baroness of Krezk and wife of Dmitri Krezkov.

facts.text: The Abbot sent word he would take her heart at dusk the next day.
The Abbot meant to give her heart to Vasilka.

name: The Abbot
summary: A celestial named Ethereal who ruled the Abbey of St. Markovia and went mad.

facts.text: The Icon of Dawn's Grace is said to be the only cure for his madness.
Fell into madness through Strahd's manipulation and flesh-crafting a bride for him.
Revealed his winged celestial form, Ethereal, when Olfin attacked.
After Aera shot him through the heart he rose as the Fallen Star: lion head, ram body, bat wings, crocodile tail.
Was killed by Olfin's smite and redeemed in the void with St. Markovia's help.
Was restored as a sleeping white-winged youth.
Had collected a lost item from everyone who travelled through Barovia.

name: Vasilka
summary: The flesh-built "perfect bride" the Abbot made for Strahd.

facts.text: Was scolded by the Abbot for tending the mongrelfolk, and fled when the fight began.
Was made after the Abbot's first, failed vessel.

name: Zorya
summary: Aera's pseudodragon companion.

facts.text: A pseudodragon found at Argynvostholt that began following Aera.
Serves as Aera's eyes in the dark.
Scouted for Gertruda during the fight with Rahadin.

name: Beucephalus
summary: Strahd's nightmare steed.

facts.text: Carried Strahd away from the castle.

name: The Flesh Golem
summary: The Abbot's hulking servant that turned on him.

facts.text: Accepted a rope crown from Aera and fought the Abbot with thrown chalices, candlesticks and a table.
Stayed on the party's side and was asked to care for the sleeping Abbot.

name: The Abbot’s First Vessel
summary: The Abbot's failed first attempt at a perfect vessel, chained beneath the abbey.

facts.text: Woke when hundreds of trapped soul fragments flooded into it.
Stood nine feet tall with six arms and a nailed-on halo, speaking in the voices of the dead.
Was killed by Liren's battleaxe, freeing the trapped souls.

name: Order of the Silver Dragon
summary: The knightly order once led by Argynvost.

facts.text: Its knightly vow was found inscribed on a table at Argynvostholt.
Recovering Argynvost's skull is part of the party's quest to restore it.

name: Belview family
summary: The Abbot's mongrelfolk family at the Abbey of St. Markovia.

facts.text: Cyrus Belview is a member of the family seen at the Abbey.
Shabasta convinced them that Cyrus had been perfected.

name: Vistani
summary: A travelling people of Barovia.

facts.text: A Vistani wagon led by Stanimir met the party near Sarepool.

name: Keepers of the Feather
summary: A group connected to the ravens of Barovia.

facts.text: Ravens who heard of the party's heroics from them acted as an honor guard.

name: Revenants of Argynvostholt
summary: Vladimir Horngaard's undead warriors.

facts.text: A Revenant at the Raven River crossroads warned the party that they are watching.

name: Brides of Strahd
summary: Strahd's three vampire brides.

facts.text: Two of the three, Volenta and Anastrasya, have been killed.
The party has killed two of the three brides.

name: Lathander
summary: The god of the dawn served by Malron.

facts.text: Malron's divine connection to the Morninglord has grown stronger.
The Icon of Dawn's Grace holds a shard of Ethereal, an angel serving the Morning Lord.
Malron told the Abbot the Morning Lord wants second chances and rebirth.

name: Ladies Three
summary: An ancient power linked to the Spear of the Huntress.

facts.text: The Spear of the Huntress is a shard of their ancient power.

name: Spirit of the Huntress
summary: A spirit linked to the Spear of the Huntress.

facts.text: Communing with her can fully restore the Spear of the Huntress.

name: Argynvostholt
summary: The ruined stronghold of the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: The party explored its graveyard and second floor and found hidden relics.
On its fourth floor, a prophecy was revealed about Argynvost's skull.
Its "Shining Beacon" can be lit by returning Argynvost's skull.

name: Tsolenka Pass
summary: A mountain pass guarded by a magical curtain and petrified vrocks.

facts.text: The Amulet of Knight's Passage lets travellers through its magical curtain.

name: Castle Ravenloft
summary: Strahd's castle.

facts.text: The party arrived for a reception with Strahd's court.
The party stayed overnight in a guest tower and was forced to sleep.
Guarded by a 1,000-foot chasm and drawbridge; the party broke in through the servants' entrance.
The party took Argynvost's skull from its Hall of Bones.
Its catacombs held the Staff of Khazan and the Spear of the Huntress.
The party left by the Brazier Room's teleportation flame.

name: Heart of Sorrow
summary: A huge pulsing red crystal heart in a tower of Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: A map in a clock showed the castle's beating heart in the north tower.
Described as a 10-foot red crystal heart with darkness swirling inside.
Aera scouted it alone; the party chose to finish the heist before destroying it.
Hangs in a 65-foot-wide tower with an unrailed spiral stair, seen as the castle's weak point.

name: Hall of Bones
summary: An ossuary in Castle Ravenloft decorated with human remains.

facts.text: Suspected to hold Argynvost's skull.
The party took the dragon skull from above its eastern doors, triggering a skeleton trap.

name: Catacombs of Ravenloft
summary: The crypts beneath Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Holds the crypts of King Dostron (34) and St. Markovia (40).
Crypts 15 (Khazan) and 34 (King Dostron) gave up the staff and spear; Crypt 18 waits empty for Ireena.
Crypts 40, 37 and 31 held the Icon of Dawn's Grace and spell scrolls; Rahadin attacked there.

name: Strahd’s Tomb
summary: Strahd's personal tomb in the catacombs.

facts.text: Named as the ultimate target of the heist.
A blood-stained tomb the party found but chose not to enter.

name: King’s Bedchamber
summary: A lavish room in the Rooms of Weeping at Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Gertruda was held here.
Holds a portrait of Tatyana; the party fought Anastrasya here.

name: Rooms of Weeping
summary: A desolate section of Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Contains the King's Bedchamber.

name: Larders of Ill Omen
summary: A cold, damp area in Castle Ravenloft's foundations.

facts.text: The party descended 40 feet into it; it holds the elevator trap.

name: Drowning Cells
summary: Flooded prison cells beneath Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Hold 3-5 feet of water; Emil was kept here.

name: Torture Chamber
summary: A flooded chamber of racks and iron maidens under a velvet-draped balcony.

facts.text: Olfin was teleported into an Iron Maiden here.
The party killed Volenta Popofsky here.

name: Serpent’s Wing
summary: A stair in Castle Ravenloft linking the dungeons to the upper floors.

facts.text: Cyrus's map showed it connects the dungeons to the royal apartments and the Witch's Coven.

name: Brazier Room
summary: A room in Castle Ravenloft with a seven-stone teleportation brazier and frozen hourglass.

facts.text: Its colored stones teleport travellers across Barovia, explaining how Strahd moves.
The party used an indigo stone to teleport to the Village of Barovia's cemetery.

name: Vallaki
summary: A town that serves as the party's base.

facts.text: The party went there for supplies.
The party rehearsed their heist there.
Lies 8.5 miles from Castle Ravenloft.

name: Blue Water Inn
summary: An inn in Vallaki and the party's base.

facts.text: Aera received Arrigal's note here.
The party planned its Ravenloft heist here.
Baron Dmitri Krezkov waited for the party here.

name: Sarepool
summary: A Vistani camp at a crossroads.

facts.text: The party met Stanimir near here.

name: Gates of Barovia
summary: Fog-wreathed gates flanked by headless statues.

facts.text: Driven on by the fog after Durst Manor, the party came to a closed gate that opened on its own and shut behind them.
A black carriage with Strahd's puzzle chest waited here.

name: Ancient Oak
summary: A massive oak tree on the Old Windmill Road carved with "K & V".

facts.text: Katarina's letter and a silver box with half a locket were found here.

name: Village of Barovia
summary: A village in Barovia where Ismark is burgomaster.

facts.text: Gertruda disappeared from here.
The party arrived in its cemetery and rested at the Burgomaster's mansion.

name: Krezk
summary: A walled village ruled by Baron Dmitri Krezkov.

facts.text: Remains under the rule of the Abbot's madness.
The party went there to save Anna Krezkova.
The party rested at the Burgomaster's house before climbing to the Abbey.

name: Abbey of Saint Markovia
summary: The abbey above Krezk ruled by the Abbot.

facts.text: The Icon of Dawn's Grace must be returned here to cure the Abbot.
The party fought the Abbot in its asylum (S15) and received bone wings in its tower (S17).
Liren and Gumbo rose from its courtyard well; a red door led to a hall of lost keepsakes below.

name: Amber Temple
summary: A temple far to the west that holds the Sunsword.

facts.text: Strahd recommended the party visit it.
The Sunsword is believed to be hidden there.
The brazier's yellow stone may lead to a mountain keep near it.

name: Raven River Crossroads
summary: A crossroads where a Revenant met the party.

facts.text: A Revenant warned the party of Vladimir Horngaard's rage here.

name: Khazan’s Tower
summary: A tower where the party first saw Khazan's rune sequence.

facts.text: The party had met the eight-schools rune sequence there before.

name: Forest Fane
summary: An ancient fane that could restore the Spear of the Huntress.

facts.text: Reconsecrating it could fully restore the Spear of the Huntress.

name: Balinoks
summary: Mountains around Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: The sun set behind its peaks as the party approached the castle.

name: The Void
summary: A misty space reached through the Icon of Dawn's Grace.

facts.text: The party found the Abbot's soul weeping in shackles there.

name: False Meadow
summary: An illusion of sunlight beneath the abbey showing the lives the heroes could have had.

facts.text: An illusion of St. Markovia offered a door out of Barovia there; it was a trap.

name: Hall of Niches
summary: A chamber under the abbey's red door full of keepsakes from lost souls.

facts.text: Held lost items, including the party's own, and was guarded by six shadows.

name: Moontouched Rapier
summary: A +1 rapier that glows faintly in darkness.

facts.text: Found by Aera behind a painting at Argynvostholt.

name: Amulet of Knight’s Passage
summary: A carved white stone that opens the curtain at Tsolenka Pass.

facts.text: Found in the hidden shelf at Argynvostholt.

name: Bracelet of Warding
summary: A bracelet that casts Sanctuary and Warding Bond.

facts.text: Found in the hidden shelf at Argynvostholt; its charges return at dawn.

name: Silver Tablet and Banner
summary: Historical relics of the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: Found in the hidden shelf at Argynvostholt.

name: Andral’s Scroll
summary: A letter urging Argynvost to make peace with Strahd.

facts.text: Found at Argynvostholt; presents Strahd's rule as stabilizing.

name: Brother Merik’s Book
summary: A book with a prayer to be read aloud.

facts.text: Said to be in the west bedchambers of Argynvostholt.

name: Tarnished Silver Locket
summary: Half of a two-piece silver locket.

facts.text: Olfin took it from a silver box atop the ancient oak.

name: Katarina’s Letter
summary: A farewell letter from Katarina to Varushka.

facts.text: Found near the ancient oak.

name: Chest of Holding
summary: A puzzle chest that works like a Bag of Holding.

facts.text: Found in Strahd's carriage; opened by solving an animal-tile riddle.
Holds up to 500 pounds and was planned as the way to smuggle relics out.
Argynvost's shrunken skull was stored in it.

name: Velvet-Trimmed Gloves
summary: Elegant gloves from Strahd's puzzle chest.

facts.text: Claimed from the puzzle chest.

name: Wolf-Trimmed Cloaks
summary: Cloaks from Strahd's puzzle chest.

facts.text: Claimed from the puzzle chest.

name: Symbol of Ravenkind
summary: A legendary holy symbol for fighting vampires.

facts.text: Held by Olfin Darning.
Olfin wielded it against Volenta.

name: Van Richten’s Maps
summary: Maps of Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Given by Van Richten to plan the heist.

name: Argynvost’s Skull
summary: The skull of the silver dragon Argynvost.

facts.text: Prophecy says returning it to its tomb could weaken Strahd's hold.
The party's top heist priority, to be returned to the beacon at Argynvostholt.
Taken from the Hall of Bones, reduced and stored in the Chest of Holding.

name: Icon of Dawn’s Grace
summary: A sentient silver statuette holding a shard of the angel Ethereal.

facts.text: Said to be the only cure for the Abbot's madness.
Found by Malron in Saint Markovia's crypt; it speaks telepathically.
Told the party the Abbot's tragic history.
Took the party into the void to redeem the Abbot.
Has not answered since the fight with the Abbot.
